import sys,random,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
from common import validate
import planning
from cost_scaling import Graph,min_cost_circulation

def build_cs(context,active):
    requests=context['requests'];offers=context['offers'];leases=context['leases']
    if not requests or not offers:return None
    cross=[];used=set()
    for oid,o in offers.items():
        cap=o['capacity']
        if cap<=0:continue
        first=int(o['network'].network_address);last=int(o['network'].broadcast_address);ot=o['time'];svc=o['service']
        listed=[]
        for rid in o['requests']:
            if not active.get(rid):continue
            r=requests[rid]
            if r['service']!=svc:continue
            if r['at']>ot:continue
            if ot>=leases[r['lease']]['end']:continue
            if first<=r['address']<=last:listed.append(rid)
        if listed:
            used.add(oid)
            for rid in listed:cross.append((rid,oid))
    if not cross:return None
    rids=sorted({r for r,_ in cross});oids=sorted(used)
    nxt=1;source=0;rqn={}
    for x in context['request_quotas']:rqn[x]=nxt;nxt+=1
    rn={}
    for x in rids:rn[x]=nxt;nxt+=1
    on={}
    for x in oids:on[x]=nxt;nxt+=1
    oqn={}
    for x in context['offer_quotas']:oqn[x]=nxt;nxt+=1
    sink=nxt;nxt+=1
    G=Graph(nxt)
    for x,node in context['request_quotas'].items():
        cap=node['capacity']
        if cap<=0:continue
        p=node['parent'];u=source if p is None else rqn[p]
        G.add(u,rqn[x],cap,0)
    for rid in rids:G.add(rqn[requests[rid]['group']],rn[rid],1,0)
    cross_edges=[]
    for rid,oid in cross:cross_edges.append(G.add(rn[rid],on[oid],1,offers[oid]['cost']))
    for oid in oids:
        o=offers[oid];G.add(on[oid],oqn[o['group']],o['capacity'],0)
    for x,node in context['offer_quotas'].items():
        cap=node['capacity']
        if cap<=0:continue
        p=node['parent'];v=sink if p is None else oqn[p]
        G.add(oqn[x],v,cap,0)
    maxcost=max((offers[oid]['cost'] for _,oid in cross),default=0)
    BIG=(len(rids)+1)*(maxcost+1)
    ts=G.add(sink,source,len(rids),-BIG)
    price,rounds=min_cost_circulation(G)
    # verify final excess? function did
    assignments=[];total=0
    for (rid,oid),e in zip(cross,cross_edges):
        f=G.initial[e]-G.cap[e]
        if f>0:
            assignments.append((rid,oid));total+=offers[oid]['cost']*f
    # verify residual reduced costs >= -1 under internal scale
    scale=G.n+1
    for e in range(len(G.to)):
        if G.cap[e]>0:
            rc=G.cost[e]*scale+price[G.fr[e]]-price[G.to[e]]
            if rc < -1:
                raise RuntimeError(('negative residual',rc,e))
    return {'resolved':len(assignments),'cost':total,'pairs':(cross,assignments)},rounds

def make_job(R,O,qnodes=6,onodes=6):
    random.seed(random.random())
    def forest(n):
        nodes=[];parents={}
        for i in range(n):
            if i==0 or random.random()<0.25:p=None
            else:
                p=random.randrange(i);d=0;x=p
                while parents[x] is not None:d+=1;x=parents[x]
                if d>=31:p=None
            parents[i]=p
            nodes.append({'id':f'n{i}','parent':None if p is None else f'n{p}','capacity':random.randrange(0,6)})
        return nodes
    rq=forest(qnodes);oq=forest(onodes)
    leases=[{'id':'l','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':2}]
    reqs=[]
    for i in range(R):
        reqs.append({'id':f'r{i}','at':0,'lease':'l','target':f'2001:db8:1:1200::{i+1}','service':'s','group':rq[i%qnodes]['id']})
    offers=[]
    for j in range(O):
        listed=random.sample([r['id'] for r in reqs],random.randrange(0,min(R,5)+1))
        offers.append({'id':f'o{j}','time':random.randrange(0,100),'service':'s','prefix':'2001:db8::/32','capacity':random.randrange(0,6),'cost':random.randrange(0,30),'group':oq[j%onodes]['id'],'requests':listed})
    return {'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':leases,'services':[{'id':'s','kind':'tcp'}],'queries':[0],'captures':[],'requests':reqs,'offers':offers,'request_quotas':rq,'offer_quotas':oq}

random.seed(123)
maxrounds=0
for trial in range(500):
    R=random.randrange(0,10);O=random.randrange(0,8)
    job=make_job(R,O)
    active={f'r{i}':random.random()<0.7 for i in range(R)}
    ctx=validate(job)
    ref=planning.solve(ctx,active)
    cs,rounds=build_cs(ctx,active)
    maxrounds=max(maxrounds,rounds)
    got={'resolved':0,'cost':0} if cs is None else {'resolved':cs['resolved'],'cost':cs['cost']}
    if (got['resolved'],got['cost'])!=(ref['resolved'],ref['cost']):
        print('MISMATCH trial',trial,'R O',R,O,'ref',ref['resolved'],ref['cost'],'cs',got,'rounds',rounds)
        print(job);print(active);sys.exit(1)
print('quota cost-scaling differential OK, maxrounds',maxrounds)
EOF
